title: Keyboard Accessibility for Core Interactions
description: Ensure core interactions (create/edit card, rename column, switch board, and a keyboard-accessible alternative to drag-and-drop) are operable via keyboard with visible focus.
spec:
1. Verify all buttons/inputs are reachable via Tab with a visible focus ring
2. Verify the card editor traps focus and closes on Escape
3. Provide a keyboard-operable way to move a card between columns (DnD is not keyboard-accessible alone)
4. Verify controls have accessible names (aria-label / associated labels)
